title: Add nested Rhat diagnostic
pr_title: Add nested Rhat diagnostic for many-short-chains MCMC convergence
pr_body:
Implements nested R-hat (Margossian et al. 2024, Definition 2.2) — a convergence diagnostic for the many-short-chains MCMC regime common on GPUs.

Closes #278

## Changes
- `blackjax.diagnostics.nested_rhat`: new function following equations 6-8 of the paper
- Exported as `blackjax.nested_rhat` at package level
- 4 test cases: convergence detection, non-convergence detection, M=1 reduces to classical Rhat, input validation

## Test plan
- [x] 172/172 diagnostics tests pass (28 new + 144 existing)
- [x] IID samples yield nested Rhat ≈ 1.0
- [x] Shifted superchain means yield nested Rhat >> 1
- [x] M=1 matches classical `potential_scale_reduction`
- [x] K < 2 raises AssertionError
